finding_F37_AD_LANDING_IS_NOT_DIFFERENT.claim: The ad-landing variant renders the same product surface as the clean URL. The tracking parameters produced no observable difference.
finding_F37_AD_LANDING_IS_NOT_DIFFERENT.evidence: Clean URL (inspector, signed out): 3,657 DOM nodes, 487 links. Ad-landing URL (authenticated Chrome): 3,668 DOM nodes, 495 links. Identical decision-aid set, identical title, identical locale.
finding_F37_AD_LANDING_IS_NOT_DIFFERENT.why_it_was_worth_checking: Ad-landing pages CAN differ from organic ones. It was assumed they did not; this checks the assumption rather than carrying it. The small node delta is attributable to the authenticated header, not to the parameters.
finding_F37_AD_LANDING_IS_NOT_DIFFERENT.caveat: One page, one moment. Not a general claim about Kayak's ad landing pages.

method_correction.what_failed: A text search for account UI ('mi cuenta', 'cerrar sesión', 'inicia sesión', 'regístrate', 'perfil') returned EMPTY, which would have supported a false conclusion that the session was not authenticated.
method_correction.why: Kayak's account control is an avatar IMAGE with no accompanying text. A text sweep cannot see it.
method_correction.how_it_was_caught: By taking a screenshot instead of trusting the empty result.
method_correction.pattern: Third occurrence this round of an empty text/selector result that was NOT absence — after the Booking.com sort options and the Google decision panels. Standing rule reinforced: an empty result is a prompt to look, never a finding.

authenticated_state_observed.evidence: Profile avatar and a saved-items (heart) control in the header
authenticated_state_observed.origin_prefilled: Madrid (MAD) — pre-populated as the departure city without the user entering it
authenticated_state_observed.default_search_state: Ida y vuelta (round trip) · 0 equipaje (0 bags) · 1 adulto, Turista (1 adult, economy)
authenticated_state_observed.suggestion_chip_verbatim_es: Vuelos a París el próximo fin de semana
authenticated_state_observed.note: A destination suggestion with a time frame, offered before any search. This is stage-1 discovery behaviour inside a transactional-adjacent product.

finding_F38_AI_SURFACE.claim: Kayak places an 'IA' (AI) entry point directly beside its wordmark in the primary header.
finding_F38_AI_SURFACE.why_it_matters: Prior desk research recorded 'assistant commoditisation' as a standing risk — that conversational planning is already shipped by competitors. This is first-hand confirmation on a third product, in its most prominent header position. Luma positioning on 'having an AI assistant' is positioning on something the market already treats as table stakes.
finding_F38_AI_SURFACE.not_observed: What the IA surface does. OWED — it was not opened.

our_product_decision_required: Decision required: Kayak pre-fills origin, suggests a destination with a time frame, and offers an AI entry point before any search — all in the first viewport, all without a booking. Luma's stage 1 has to be at least this good to be noticed.
Decision required: 'IA' beside the wordmark on a third competitor confirms conversational planning is table stakes. Luma cannot differentiate on having an assistant.
